title: Chersonese

inlines.v: CHERSONESE, noun A peninsula; a tract of land of any indefinite extent, which is nearly surrounded by water, but united to a larger tract by a neck of land or isthmus; as the Cimbric chersonese or Jutland; the Tauric chersonese or Crimea.
